title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #14 (Term 2)

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #14 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Whom did the angel say was expecting a child in old age? (1 mark)
   A. Elizabeth
   B. Ruth
   C. Hannah
   D. Sarah

2. Who was told about the birth of Jesus in a dream? (1 mark)
   A. Joseph
   B. Herod
   C. Pilate
   D. Zechariah

3. What was John's main work? (1 mark)
   A. Building the temple
   B. Ruling Israel
   C. Leading an army
   D. Preparing the way for the Lord

4. What was Zechariah's job? (1 mark)
   A. Soldier
   B. Tax collector
   C. Priest
   D. Fisherman

5. Which quality did Bartimaeus show when he kept shouting to Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Pride
   B. Anger
   C. Laziness
   D. Faith and persistence

6. Which is a way of thanking God? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring Him
   B. Praying and singing praise
   C. Being rude
   D. Complaining

7. Which habit helps to prevent many diseases? (1 mark)
   A. Sharing dirty cups
   B. Washing hands with soap
   C. Not bathing
   D. Playing in dirty water

8. What happened after Jesus spoke? (1 mark)
   A. The dead man sat up and began to talk
   B. The crowd left
   C. He ran away
   D. Nothing

9. Who had died in the story? (1 mark)
   A. A king
   B. The only son of a widow
   C. A priest
   D. A soldier

10. Which of these is a result of revenge? (1 mark)
   A. Friendship grows
   B. Peace grows
   C. The problem gets bigger
   D. Everyone is safe

11. A classmate breaks your pencil by accident. What is the best response? (1 mark)
   A. Tell others lies
   B. Shout at him
   C. Break his pencil
   D. Forgive and accept the apology

12. Why should we help promptly? (1 mark)
   A. Helping is a waste
   B. Needs may be urgent
   C. Delay is better
   D. Nobody needs help

13. What should you do before going to an unfamiliar place to help someone? (1 mark)
   A. Tell your parents or teacher
   B. Take valuables
   C. Go at night
   D. Go secretly

14. What does the parable teach about every person? (1 mark)
   A. Nobody matters
   B. Every person is precious to God
   C. Only rich people matter
   D. Only adults matter

15. What rests in the branches of the tree? (1 mark)
   A. Snakes
   B. Goats
   C. Birds
   D. Lions

16. What is baptism? (1 mark)
   A. A Christian act of washing with water in the name of Father, Son and Holy Spirit
   B. A journey
   C. A dance
   D. A meal

17. Who visited Jesus at night? (1 mark)
   A. Balaam
   B. Samson
   C. Zacchaeus
   D. Nicodemus

18. What does it mean to trust someone? (1 mark)
   A. To hide from them
   B. To argue with them
   C. To fear them
   D. To believe they are honest and will not harm you

19. Which verse says that truthful lips endure for ever? (1 mark)
   A. Acts 2:38
   B. Proverbs 1:7
   C. John 3:16
   D. Proverbs 12:19

20. What does integrity mean? (1 mark)
   A. Doing right when nobody is watching
   B. Being lucky
   C. Copying others
   D. Being popular

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. State three qualities of Mary that a child can copy. (3 marks)

22. Give three ways of living a righteous life. (3 marks)

23. Explain what the parable of the mustard seed teaches about God's kingdom. (3 marks)

24. Give four ways in which we can care for our eyes and health. (4 marks)

25. Explain why sexual purity is important and how children can begin to live a holy life like Mary. (5 marks)

26. Who was Nicodemus? (2 marks)

27. Explain why Christians should help those in need. (3 marks)

28. State three things that show that Nicodemus changed. (3 marks)

29. State two ways in which Bartimaeus showed faith in Jesus. (2 marks)

30. State two lessons from Joseph's response to temptation. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #14 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Elizabeth
   Mary's relative Elizabeth was expecting a baby.

2. A — Joseph
   Matthew 1:20 says an angel appeared to Joseph in a dream.

3. D — Preparing the way for the Lord
   Luke 1:76 says he would prepare the way.

4. C — Priest
   Luke 1:5 says he was a priest.

5. D — Faith and persistence
   He believed that Jesus could help him.

6. B — Praying and singing praise
   Praise and prayer express thanks.

7. B — Washing hands with soap
   Clean hands prevent the spread of germs.

8. A — The dead man sat up and began to talk
   Luke 7:15 says he sat up and began to talk.

9. B — The only son of a widow
   The young man was her only son.

10. C — The problem gets bigger
   Revenge starts a cycle of hurting.

11. D — Forgive and accept the apology
   Forgiveness restores friendship.

12. B — Needs may be urgent
   Quick help reduces suffering.

13. A — Tell your parents or teacher
   Safety comes first when helping.

14. B — Every person is precious to God
   God searches for each person.

15. C — Birds
   The birds perched in its branches.

16. A — A Christian act of washing with water in the name of Father, Son and Holy Spirit
   Baptism is a sign of new life.

17. D — Nicodemus
   John 3:1-2 says Nicodemus came at night.

18. D — To believe they are honest and will not harm you
   Trust means believing someone is reliable.

19. D — Proverbs 12:19
   Proverbs 12:19 says this.

20. A — Doing right when nobody is watching
   Integrity is honesty in private.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Trust in God, obedience, humility, purity.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each quality.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Tell the truth, obey parents, share, avoid bad company, say sorry, pray and read the Bible.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: It began small, with Jesus and a few followers, but it grows large and gives shelter to many.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for small beginning, 1 for growth, 1 for shelter or many people.

24. (4 marks)
   Answer: Keep hands clean; do not read in dim light; go to the clinic when eyes hurt; eat vegetables and fruit; rest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

25. (5 marks)
   Answer: The body is a gift from God, and sexual relations are meant for marriage. Purity keeps us safe and honours God. Children can begin by respecting their bodies, avoiding harmful places and media, obeying parents, praying and saying no to wrong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for body as gift, 1 for marriage, 1 for honouring God, 1 for respecting body or avoiding harm, 1 for a prayer or obedience.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: A Pharisee and a member of the Jewish ruling council who visited Jesus at night.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Pharisee or leader and 1 for visiting Jesus.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jesus taught it; it shows love; it makes the community stronger.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: He defended Jesus fairly; he brought spices for Jesus' burial; he showed courage.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid sign.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: He called out to Jesus; he kept shouting when told to be quiet; he came at once; he asked for sight.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: Say no clearly, run away, remember that sin is against God, stay faithful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each lesson.
